በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n)
ሎቱ: ለ — to him, for him (preposition ለ- with 3m sg suffix -tu: ሎቱ)
ኢኮነ: ኮነ — he did not become (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n)
በከመ: ከመ — according as, just as (በ- + ከመ, conjunction)
ለእለ: እለ — to those who (ለ- 'to' + relative pronoun pl.)
ለሊሁ: ለሊሁ — he himself, his very self
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ወቦ: ቦ — and there is (ወ- + existential ቦ 'there is')
አማልክተ: አምላክ — gods (noun; plural አማልክት, accusative form)
ወአንሰ: አነ — and as for me (ወ- 'and' + 1s pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
ወተናገሮ: ተናገረ — and he spoke with him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, reciprocal ተ- stem, n-g-r; + -ኦ 'him')
ወኣወርዳ: አወረደ — and I will bring her down (ወ- 'and' + 1s imperfect, causative አ- stem of ወረደ, w-r-d; + -ኣ 'her')
ለታቦተ: ታቦት — to/of the ark (ለ- + noun, construct 'ark of')
ወእምድኅሬሁ: ድኅረ — and after him (ወ- 'and' + እም- 'from' + preposition with 3ms suffix -ሁ)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as, up to (preposition)
ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity')
ምድረ: ምድር — land, earth (noun, f.; construct 'land of' / accusative)
ለዘርእከ: ዘርእ — to your seed (ለ- 'to' + noun + -ka '2ms your')
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ
ይኩን: ኮነ — let him be (3m sg jussive, k-w-n)
ወነግሠ: ነግሠ — and he reigned (ወ- + 3m sg perfect, n-g-š)
ወአዕረፈ: አዕረፈ — and he rested, died (ወ- + 3m sg perfect, ʾ-ʿ-r-f)
ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
ተዐድዎ: ተዐደወ — transgressing, overstepping (verbal noun of ተዐደወ; the final -ዎ is the verbal-noun ending, not 'his')
ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
ነግሠ: ነግሠ — he reigned (3m sg perfect, n-g-š)
አዕረፈ: አዕረፈ — he rested, died, reposed (3ms perfect, causative አ- stem, r-f)
ወእም: እም — and from (ወ- 'and' + preposition; here with the next word, ወእም ድኅረ 'and after')
ሞተ: ሞተ — he died (3ms perfect, G, m-w-t); ድኅረ ሞተ ሴም 'after Shem died'
